_comment: Setup value space per lever for the setup engine: typical-window nominal + span (soft edge, 'engineer may exceed') and edge exemptions. Hard edges stay in setup_parameters.json value_space.
_comment_parameter_windows: One entry per registry key (46). nominal + span come from the registry's typical_window / value_space: span = half the typical window width (e.g. arb_fl 4 +/- 1 from 3..5); without a typical window, nominal = value_space midpoint and span = half the legal range (wider, weaker, flagged). Plain enums without an underlying number stay null (arb_front_mount, wing_position). A null window or a non-numeric current value gives a neutral headroom term.

springs_front.source: value_space.options = [220, 250, 280, 310] N/mm (a numeric enum): nominal = range midpoint (220+310)/2, span = half-width (310-220)/2. The midpoint is not itself a legal option; it is the window centre for distance purposes, not a recommendable setting.

springs_rear.source: value_space.options = [240, 260, 280, 300] N/mm: nominal = (240+300)/2, span = (300-240)/2. Same caveat as springs_front: the midpoint is not a legal option.

damper_bump_ls_fl.source: typical_window.reference_point_NBR = 10; span = half the full legal range (0-18 clicks)/2 = 9. Only a reference point exists, no team-typical span, so this is deliberately a wide, weak window, not a real tolerance.

damper_rebound_ls_fl.source: typical_window.reference_point_NBR=7; span=half the full legal range (0-18)/2=9, same fallback.

damper_bump_ls_fr.source: typical_window.reference_point_NBR=10; span=half the full legal range (0-18)/2=9, same fallback.

damper_rebound_ls_fr.source: typical_window.reference_point_NBR=7; span=half the full legal range (0-18)/2=9, same fallback.

damper_bump_ls_rl.source: typical_window.reference_point_NBR=10; span=half the full legal range (0-18)/2=9, same fallback.

damper_rebound_ls_rl.source: typical_window.reference_point_NBR=13; span=half the full legal range (0-18)/2=9, same fallback.

damper_bump_ls_rr.source: typical_window.reference_point_NBR=10; span=half the full legal range (0-18)/2=9, same fallback.

damper_rebound_ls_rr.source: typical_window.reference_point_NBR=13; span=half the full legal range (0-18)/2=9, same fallback.

ride_height_front.note: The registry gives a floor only (standard - 2 mm, diffuser floor limit; no upper limit). The symmetric span here only drives the headroom tie-break and the soft 'engineer may exceed' note; it never blocks a step.

diff_position.source: No typical_window nominal exists, so nominal = value_space range midpoint (1+5)/2 = 3 and span = half the full range (5-1)/2 = 2.

wing_position.note: Left null: a physical anchor exists (setup_parameters.json angles_deg [7.3, 8.3, 9.3], midpoint 8.3 deg = option P9), but the outing's setup data stores the enum label ('P9'), not the angle, so a window in degrees would compare against a different representation. A label -> angle mapping in code is needed first.

camber_fl.source: typical_window.base = -3.5; span = half the full legal range (-4.8 to -2.0 deg)/2 = 1.4. Only a base value exists, no team-typical span, so this is deliberately the full legal range, not a real tolerance.

camber_fr.source: typical_window.base=-3.5; span=half the full legal range (-4.8 to -2.0)/2=1.4, same fallback as camber_fl.

camber_rl.source: typical_window.base=-3.2; span=half the full legal range (-4.8 to -2.0)/2=1.4, same fallback.

camber_rr.source: typical_window.base=-3.2; span=half the full legal range (-4.8 to -2.0)/2=1.4, same fallback.

tc_lat.source: typical_window.baseline = 5 ('normal conditions'); span = half the full legal range (0-11)/2 = 5.5. Only a baseline exists, no team-typical span, so this is deliberately the full legal range.

tc_lon.source: typical_window.baseline=5 ('normal conditions'); span=half the full legal range (0-11)/2=5.5, same fallback as tc_lat.

abs_position.note: Categorical, not one monotonic axis (registry direction_semantics.type), so a nominal + span distance does not apply; the headroom term is neutral for this lever.

brake_bias.note: Recommendation target (setup_parameters.json); nominal and span stay null because the current value cannot be evaluated until the brake-bias channel is identified (setup_parameters.json brake_bias notes).

splitter_offset.source: setup_parameters.json splitter_offset value_space {min:-4, max:4, step:1 mm, default:0}, typical window = full legal range: nominal = default = range midpoint 0, span = half-width 4, so headroom is evaluable for the splitter. The hard forward edge (negative extreme, splitter / track contact, track-dependent) stays with the window-edge labels, not with this distance.

_comment_edge_normal_state_params: Edge exemptions per (parameter, direction) where the edge is the lever's normal resting state, e.g. ride_height_front pinned at its lower limit. Standing practice is recorded here, never as an edit to an engineer rule. An exempt edge gives no blocked_at_edge: the candidate stays proposed with an edge_normal_state_note (live value filled in), and other actions are still checked and can block. Only 'decrease' for ride_height_front; moving off the pin is an ordinary move.
